title: XAUUSD 4H-led scalping (scalp4h-v1): frozen out-of-sample evaluation on 2019-2020 tick-built M1 history
why_this_period: Every XAUUSD dataset examined before this registration starts on or after 2022-09-01 (M15/H1 Phase 2/2A, M5 2025-06, M1 2026-07). The broker serves tick history for 2019-01..2020-12 (2021-01..2025-04 unavailable); bar history is capped by the terminal's 100,000 max-bars setting, and raising it requires an MT5 restart (not approved).

data.source: MetaQuotes-Demo XAUUSD ticks via trading.connectors.mt5 (read-only, copy_ticks_range, COPY_TICKS_INFO)
data.bars: M1 built from bid ticks (OHLC of bid; tick_volume = tick count; spread_points = minimum spread in the minute)
data.warmup: candidates before 2019-02-01 are excluded (4H EMA50 warm-up); evaluation window is 2019-02-01..2020-12-31
validation_before_evaluation: tick-built M1 vs broker M1 on an overlap window (2026-08)
tick-built H1 vs broker H1 bars for 2019-2020
daily break and weekend structure consistent with 17:00 New York close
missing minutes vs CME Globex gold calendar
spread distribution by New York hour
data.abort_if: tick-built bars disagree materially with broker bars or the server time conversion cannot be confirmed; then the limitation is documented and a prospective shadow test is proposed instead

frozen_from: most-selected walk-forward parameters per variant in research/output/mtf/scalp4h_v1/xauusd.json (2026-07-27..2026-11-06). No re-selection on 2019-2020.

account.event_blackouts: scheduled FOMC decisions 2019-2020 from federalreserve.gov fomchistorical pages (unscheduled/notation votes excluded: not knowable in advance)

base.spread: 2026 tick-spread p50 by New York hour (identical to previous XAU research)

historical_spread.spread: 2019-2020 tick-measured p50 and p90 by New York hour

costs.note: the same cost scenarios are applied to all three variants

metrics: matched random entries (20 seeds, per variant)
B4H - B and B4H - B4H_only mean R differences with bootstrap CI
diagnostic only: the full 12-point grid per variant (never used to choose parameters)

supported_only_if_all: base mean R > 0 and its 95% CI lower bound > 0
net return > 0 with commission 7 per lot and slippage 0.30
mean R above at least 18 of 20 matched random runs
decision_rule_B4H.improvement_over_B_claimed_only_if: B4H - B mean R difference has a 95% CI lower bound > 0
decision_rule_B4H.if_supported: grounds only for a separately approved, pre-registered prospective shadow test; not for trading
decision_rule_B4H.if_not_supported: the 4H-led scalper is not validated; no re-tuning on 2019-2020

single_run: the evaluation is run once on the frozen variants; any code fix after the first run is disclosed with both results
